theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → (∀ (T : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P), ‖T.starProjection (inner ℝ x a • e - inner ℝ x e • a)‖ ≤ ‖Q.starProjection x‖ ∧ ‖Q.starProjection x‖ ≤ ‖x‖) ∧ ∀ t α : ℝ, 0 < t → |α| < Real.pi / 2 → (0 < inner ℝ (t • (Real.cos α • a + Real.sin α • e)) a ∧ ‖t • (Real.cos α • a + Real.sin α • e)‖ = t ∧ Real.arctan (inner ℝ (t • (Real.cos α • a + Real.sin α • e)) e / inner ℝ (t • (Real.cos α • a + Real.sin α • e)) a) = α ∧ Q.starProjection (t • (Real.cos α • a + Real.sin α • e)) = t • (Real.cos α • a + Real.sin α • e) ∧ ‖Q.starProjection (inner ℝ (t • (Real.cos α • a + Real.sin α • e)) a • e - inner ℝ (t • (Real.cos α • a + Real.sin α • e)) e • a)‖ = t) ∧ ∀ x : Euclid P, 0 < inner ℝ x a → ‖x‖ = t → Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a) = α → x ≠ t • (Real.cos α • a + Real.sin α • e) → ‖Q.starProjection x‖ < t
